correctness.rationale: The exact first-Hermite Bargmann formula reduces the zeros to a radial equation and a d-fold angular sign. Exterior branches increase strictly; the middle branch is controlled by quadratic P(s) with discriminant (d-2)^2-8k. At a positive discriminant the two simple stationary points produce two sharp folds and 3d/4d/5d root counts. At zero discriminant the unique resonant radial contact is cubic and no additional circle appears. Exact polar Jacobian gives each charge; origin degree k-1 and winding at infinity give total m-1. Real boundary c=0 excluded. Standalone checker passed 4,126 finite assertions, not a proof of infinite cases.

value.rationale: An all-index global census of STFT zero polygons and signs for two finite Hermite modes is a motivated zero-topology and phase-space interference invariant. The sharp gap condition and amplitude window identify when pairs of d-gons appear, including the smallest 15-to-25-zero transition, and a distinct infinite arithmetic family of cubic-contact degeneracies. Existing existence-only results do not provide the phase boundaries or charge conservation in this model. This is an exact classification for a natural two-mode object, not arbitrary numerical slicing.
